name: Wireless Device Manager Pro
notes: Paid Pro edition. Multiple devices, favorites, groups, low-battery alerts, dashboard, Cycle Device and capability-gated control. Sole visible hardware defaults automatically; battery values remain device-reported.
release_gate: locked dependency install and npm audit with 0 vulnerabilities
five Pro profiles: Standard, Mini, XL, Plus and Neo
device-neutral bundled Pro controls and group workflow pages
x64 and ARM64 self-contained native Windows Bluetooth bridge publish
one-shot bridge snapshot and persistent stdio protocol smoke
official Elgato Stream Deck CLI validation
PackRat Lite Pro Portfolio Audit and Rat Ship Marketplace Routing CI
Bluetooth audio-control physical matrix explicitly waived by product owner for initial release

profiles.note: Pro bundles device-neutral DEVICE_1 / DEVICE_2 controls, dashboard and Cycle Device on the primary workflow plus separate group dashboard pages. Plus/Neo remain key-only.

upsell.note: Publish Pro first so Lite can rebuild against the exact verified direct Pro Marketplace URL. Do not invent or guess the destination.

final_boundary: READY_TO_SHIP with an explicit product-owner waiver for unverified Bluetooth A2DP/HFP physical connect/disconnect. Maya X USB/2.4 GHz telemetry, Stream Deck runtime, Property Inspector, profiles, visual audits, Elgato validation and packaging are release-cleared.

risk_acceptance.accepted_scope: Bluetooth A2DP/HFP physical connect/disconnect hardware matrix
risk_acceptance.rationale: No Bluetooth adapter is available on the current QA host. Automated capability-boundary tests, native bridge tests, Elgato validation, packaging, and real Maya X USB/2.4 GHz telemetry QA are clean. Ship is explicitly allowed with this Bluetooth hardware path unverified and subject to a later fix if needed.

known_release_risks: Bluetooth A2DP/HFP connect/disconnect has not been physically exercised on real Bluetooth audio hardware.
Device-reported battery percentages may remain coarse or plateau, as observed with the Maya X receiver; PackRat intentionally does not smooth or invent battery values.
